properties.name: selected_id
properties.comment: The selected item's stable ID, or empty; a view, since replacing the items keeps or clears it. A change makes the item active and raises selection_changed; an ID not in the model throws std::out_of_range.
hand: a view onto selected_id_, which set_items retains or clears and collapsing an ancestor moves; write_view validates and raises selection_changed

properties.name: item_height
properties.comment: The row height in logical units, 14 to 256 (std::invalid_argument otherwise).
prepare: throw std::invalid_argument("TreeView item height must be finite and between 14 and 256");

properties.name: indentation
properties.comment: The width of one tree level in logical units, 8 to 96 (std::invalid_argument otherwise).
prepare: throw std::invalid_argument("TreeView indentation must be finite and between 8 and 96");

properties.name: show_expanders
properties.comment: Whether expandable items draw their expander glyph.

properties.name: font
properties.comment: The rows' font (Font). Throws std::invalid_argument for an invalid FontSpec; any write marks the font as set from code.
prepare: if (!valid_font_spec(incoming)) throw std::invalid_argument("TreeView font is invalid");

properties.name: image_list
properties.comment: The images that the items' image keys name; a list must be alive and belong to this view's Window (std::invalid_argument otherwise). A change follows the new list's changes.
hand: prepare_write: a live list of the own Window; written: resubscribe to the list's changes

not_properties.name: items
not_properties.reason: the model is replaced whole and validated as a set; collections stay methods

not_properties.name: top_row
not_properties.reason: scroll state clamped by layout: the read differs from the write
